title: A/R Collection: Cancel on the switch prompt leaves the report as it was
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has overdue invoices at {Location-A} and one, {Invoice-A}, at {Location-B}; more than 20 other customers have overdue invoices.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-05 Stay Put.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with "Past due: 1-30 days" ticked, the "Amount" header clicked once, {Customer-A}'s group expanded and the page scrolled so {Invoice-A} is in the middle of the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Copy the page address.
  2. Note which rows are at the top and bottom of the screen.
  3. Click {Invoice-A}'s number.
  4. Click "Cancel".
  5. Compare the page address with the copied one.
  6. Look at the filters, the sort, the expanded groups and the scroll position.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the address is copied.
  • Step 2: noted.
  • Step 3: the "Switch location?" dialog opens.
  • Step 4: the dialog closes and you stay on the report.
  • Step 5: the address is the same.
  • Step 6: the same Past due filter, the Amount sort, {Customer-A}'s group still expanded and the same scroll position.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R5: “"Cancel" closes the prompt; the user stays on the report exactly where they were: same page address, filters, sort, expanded groups and scroll position.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Click an invoice at another enrolled location | Title "Switch location?", message "This work order is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?" | Dialog on the report; "Switch location" switches and opens, "Cancel" stays”
